about.title: About Caspian Center
about.subtitle: Over 20 years of experience providing specialized nuclear medicine services with the most advanced equipment and expert medical staff
about.storyTitle: Pioneer in Nuclear Medicine in Iran
about.storyText1: Caspian Nuclear Medical Center was founded in 2000 in Qazvin with the goal of providing specialized nuclear medicine imaging services.
about.storyText2: Over two decades, through continuous investment in equipment and medical staff training, we have become one of the most advanced nuclear medicine centers in northwestern Iran.
about.visionText: Becoming the national reference for nuclear medicine
about.missionText: Providing specialized nuclear medicine services with precision and high safety
about.valuesText: Honesty, precision, respect for the patient and continuous progress
about.commitmentText: Cooperation with more than 16 insurance companies for easy patient access
